item.title: RPI Reads: Last Chance to Win Herman the Blue Whale
item.description:
There’s still time to complete RPI Reads! Submit your program materials (online or in person) by Monday, August 3, to be entered into a raffle to win Herman the Blue Whale, the RPI Reads mascot. As a thank-you, everyone who submits in person will receive a small treat while supplies last. (Visit library.rpi.edu/news for full details)

For information about sharing your news or events, or to change your subscription settings, visit morningmail.rpi.edu.
